definition: Midpoint = 50/50 blend of the supplied original/native normal stroke and the previous full native-contrast stroke. Half = 50% of the full native-contrast stroke, ignoring the normal baseline. Outline and focus widths are 1px in either treatment. Elevation shadows are excluded. Existing panel inset fills and all native state resets stay as they were; they are not outline strokes.
source: GNOME Shell 50.6 and libadwaita 1.9.4; themes/gtk.css and themes/shell-{light,dark}.css remain authoritative.
